data_notice: Invented for an offline sample. All names are placeholders. The sample is local in style only; no real place names are used. No real sanctions list, regulator action or news report is represented.

freshness_rule.basis: Source snapshot age, not article age. The 365-day freshness limit is for this sample only, not a regulatory rule.

status_scope: Planned sample statuses, not a live search log. Source result means a finding for any monitored subject in its supplied articles. Per-subject results are in answer-key.json. Freshness describes the dated snapshot requested or supplied; current does not mean retrieval succeeded.
